items.sentenceBn: তার চারটি শক্ত থাবাই বাঁকানো ঘাসের পাহাড়ের ওপর দৃঢ়ভাবে রাখা আছে।

grammar.presentContinuous: His sturdy cub paws are balancing steadily on the shaded slope.
grammar.simplePast: Four sturdy cub paws carried him right up to the sprout.
grammar.simplePresent: Sturdy cub paws keep the little bear steady while he leans.
grammar.question: Where are the bear's sturdy cub paws standing?

items.name: Hill
items.sentence: Cool blue-green shadows cover the broad shaded green hill beneath the evergreen.
items.sentenceBn: চিরসবুজ গাছের নিচে প্রশস্ত ছায়াঘেরা সবুজ পাহাড়টি শীতল নীলচে-সবুজ ছায়ায় ঢাকা।

grammar.presentContinuous: The shaded green hill is sheltering the new shoot from noon heat.
grammar.simplePast: Soft grass covered the curved shaded green hill in spring.
grammar.simplePresent: A shaded green hill gives the young pine a peaceful place to start.
grammar.question: Why is most of this shaded green hill bathed in cool shadow?

items.name: Grass
items.sentence: Bright yellow grass glows along the warm sunlit edge at the top of the mound.
items.sentenceBn: ঢিবির উপরের উষ্ণ রোদেলা কিনারা জুড়ে উজ্জ্বল হলদেটে ঘাস জ্বলজ্বল করছে।

grammar.presentContinuous: The warm sunlit edge is gleaming brightly just beyond the shadow.
grammar.simplePast: Golden afternoon light touched the warm sunlit edge above the cub.
grammar.simplePresent: A warm sunlit edge frames the cool green shadow in bright gold.
grammar.question: Where does sunlight touch the hill at the top of the frame?

title: A Young Pine Sapling Stands Tall

items.name: Sapling
items.sentence: Standing straight in the clearing, the young pine sapling stretches toward the sky.
items.sentenceBn: খোলা জায়গায় সোজা দাঁড়িয়ে থাকা তরুণ পাইন চারাগাছটি আকাশের দিকে মাথা তুলেছে।

grammar.presentContinuous: The young pine sapling is growing stronger in the morning light.
grammar.simplePast: A tiny seed turned into this sturdy young pine sapling.
grammar.simplePresent: The young pine sapling stands proudly atop the small soil mound.
grammar.question: What grew out of the seed that the cub and evergreen planted?

items.name: Pine needles
items.sentence: Bright green needles spread out like a neat fresh needle fan at the top.
items.sentenceBn: চারাটির মাথায় উজ্জ্বল সবুজ পাতাগুলো একটি সুন্দর তাজা পাতার পাখার মতো ছড়িয়ে আছে।

grammar.presentContinuous: The fresh needle fan is catching gentle sunlight at the tip.
grammar.simplePast: A bright fresh needle fan opened out above the thin brown stem.
grammar.simplePresent: Each leaf in the fresh needle fan reaches upward for warmth.
grammar.question: What shape do the bright green needles form at the top?

items.name: Stem
items.sentence: A slender wooden stem lifts the tender green needles safely above the pebbles.
items.sentenceBn: একটি সরু কাঠের কাণ্ড কোমল সবুজ পাতাগুলোকে নুড়িপাথরের ওপর নিরাপদে তুলে ধরেছে।

grammar.presentContinuous: The slender wooden stem is standing upright in the soft breeze.
grammar.simplePast: A slender wooden stem pushed upward through the mound of earth.
grammar.simplePresent: The slender wooden stem connects the roots in the soil to the needles.
grammar.question: How tall does the slender wooden stem lift the green needles?

items.name: Soil mound
items.sentence: Tiny stones dot the pebbled soil mound packed neatly around the sapling's base.
items.sentenceBn: চারাগাছের গোড়ায় সুন্দর করে চেপে দেওয়া নুড়িমাখা মাটির ঢিবির গায়ে ছোট ছোট পাথর ছড়ানো আছে।

grammar.presentContinuous: The pebbled soil mound is anchoring the young tree securely in place.
grammar.simplePast: Warm spring soil formed a sturdy pebbled soil mound around the roots.
grammar.simplePresent: A pebbled soil mound supports the sapling right on top of the hill.
grammar.question: What surrounds the base of the young pine sapling?

items.name: Branch
items.sentence: In the top corner, a hovering branch tip lingers like a quiet guardian above.
items.sentenceBn: উপরের কোণায় একটি ওপরে ঝুলে থাকা ডালের আগা নীরব অভিভাবকের মতো রয়ে গেছে।

grammar.presentContinuous: The hovering branch tip is watching silently from the upper right.
grammar.simplePast: A gentle hovering branch tip reached near the growing sapling.
grammar.simplePresent: That hovering branch tip reminds us of the giant evergreen close by.
grammar.question: What peeks into the frame at the top right corner?

items.name: Hilltop
items.sentence: Soft green turf stretches across the peaceful sunlit grassy hilltop.
items.sentenceBn: শান্ত রোদেলা ঘাসে ঢাকা পাহাড়চূড়া জুড়ে কোমল সবুজ ঘাস বিছিয়ে আছে।

grammar.presentContinuous: The sunlit grassy hilltop is glowing softly under the morning light.
grammar.simplePast: Fresh grass carpeted the sunlit grassy hilltop around the mound.
grammar.simplePresent: A sunlit grassy hilltop gives the young sapling plenty of open sky.
grammar.question: Where does the young pine sapling stand in the bright clearing?

items.name: Sky
items.sentence: Pale blue and lavender mist shimmer across the luminous morning sky.
items.sentenceBn: হালকা নীল ও ল্যাভেন্ডার কুয়াশা উজ্জ্বল ভোরের আকাশ জুড়ে ঝলমল করছে।

grammar.presentContinuous: The luminous morning sky is brightening gently behind the little pine.
grammar.simplePast: A soft luminous morning sky welcomed the newly sprouted sapling.
grammar.simplePresent: The luminous morning sky wraps the hillside in a calm, hopeful glow.
grammar.question: What colors shine behind the sapling in the luminous morning sky?
